_note: Curated semiotic-code blocks for the geology globe, keyed by need. These are HAND-CODED (Michael's monthly coding exercise) and persist between rebuilds — build_geology.py merges them into GEO as needs[].code. Data fields (counts, clusters) regenerate from corpus.json every build; THESE do not. The per-code `status` (residual/dominant/emergent) is what the Code Velocity card diffs month-over-month. Add a need key here when a theme gets coded. Copyright rule: img values are hotlinks to publishers' own servers, never stored locally.
